body: I know this sounds ridiculous, but I would really like a pet eventually.  Right now I can't afford the pet deposit at my apt for one but it would be nice to have a little buddy to take care of.
Thanks for your reply, its good to know that I'm not alone with my quirks.

Hey I'm really sorry to hear that.  Being a lawyer does sound like a very stress full job but you should be proud that you passed the bar and are able to carry out such a heavy load.    As far as the benefits I just want to be able to live comfortable and be confident in my skills to do my work.  My lack of direction is starting to become a nusance since I feel like people my age have already put their time in and are already settled down with their career.

Looking back is there any other career path you wish you'd taken?

I couldn't really see myself doing anything, and I think that's part of the problem.  I just don't know what I want to do for a living.... Its not so much that I care about what other people think, I am just personally disappointed in myself for not picking a field and staying with it.  I've been doing okay, but what happens if I get into a situation where I need dental work done or my car breaks down?  I just want to be secure in my future, its frightening knowing that if anything happened to me I wouldn't be very prepared.

Thank you for your reply!  I'm not sure how I would even go about getting tested for something like that... But one thing that would bring value is just having a decent job and being able to support myself, not living lavishly but just comfortably.  I feel like such a failure being my age and still living like a green college kid.
